scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the six official Duskmourn: House of Horror Magic Story episodes (2024-08-19 to 2024-08-30) and the Planeswalker's Guide to Duskmourn. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: valgavoth

quotes.quote: Originally, the House was an ordinary dwelling, within which the demonic entity known as Valgavoth had been imprisoned.
To stop themselves from being devoured, they'd bound the demon to the physical structure of the house and fled.

claims.summary: Valgavoth was summoned by earlier owners of the House and bound to its physical structure.

claims.subject: valgavoth

quotes.quote: Eventually, he was able to swallow up the entirety of the plane within the walls of the House in a period known as the Ascension.
Unable to break the binding, he found a way to work around it instead by redefining and expanding the boundaries of what counted as his prison.

claims.summary: Valgavoth expands his prison until the House swallows the whole plane (the Ascension), creating Duskmourn.

claims.subject: marina_vendrell

quotes.quote: Trapped and unable to feed, the demon had sunk into hibernation and bided his time—until Marina came along and unwittingly loosened his shackles.

claims.summary: Marina Vendrell unwittingly loosens Valgavoth's shackles.
claims.limitation: Unwitting partial release; he remains technically bound to the House.

claims.subject: the_wanderer

quotes.quote: Winter was looking at them like they had made the biggest mistake the world had ever known by coming here, but they hadn't arrived by mistake: they'd been looking for Nashi.
"Can it take us to Nashi?" asked the Wanderer.

claims.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and their companions enter the House to find Nashi.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

quotes.quote: Jace and Kaito stood back to back, making it harder for something to ambush them.

claims.summary: Jace Beleren fights alongside Kaito inside the House.

claims.subject: kaito

quotes.quote: "An artificial Omenpath," said Kaito. "My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting, and a piece of the House that I took with me when I had to planeswalk away.

claims.summary: The escape route is an artificial Omenpath built from Kaito's spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting and a piece of the House.
claims.limitation: Kaito's explanation in dialogue; a joint construction with Proft and Aminatou.

claims.subject: valgavoth

quotes.quote: Winter caught the motion out of the corner of his eye and turned to see Valgavoth's tendrils extending toward him.
Pulling Winter higher to his leaking, punctured chest, Valgavoth melted into the ceiling, and all in the House was silence.

claims.summary: After the survivors escape, a wounded Valgavoth seizes Winter.
claims.limitation: Winter's fate after capture is not shown.

claims.subject: tyvar

quotes.quote: Tyvar Kell, elf prince of Kaldheim, stood shirtless in the snow

claims.summary: Tyvar Kell is an elf prince of Kaldheim.

claims.subject: zimone

quotes.quote: The others had gone with Zimone back to Strixhaven; Tyvar and Niko had seemed excited about the prospect of a game called "Mage Tower."

claims.summary: After the escape, Zimone returns to Strixhaven with Tyvar and Niko.

claims.subject: valgavoth

quotes.quote: Even more slowly than it had appeared, the door swung open, and a cool wind blew through the office. Proft stiffened.
As it finished forming, the space at the center smoothed, becoming a door engraved with white-winged moths.

claims.summary: In the epilogue a moth-engraved door, the House's motif, appears in Proft's mental office.
claims.limitation: The door's source is not named; Valgavoth's involvement is inferred from the moth motif.

claims.subject: marina_vendrell

quotes.quote: His name is Valgavoth—Val—and he was summoned here and bound by one of the owners before us.
Marina Vendrell The last surviving member of the Vendrell family continues to live in the House—sort of.

claims.summary: Marina Vendrell, last of the Vendrells, still lives in the House and knows the demon as 'Val'.
claims.limitation: Quoted from Marina's diary as Zimone reads it aloud; the guide says her awareness of the truth is unclear.

remaining: Nashi's farewell to the scroll and Aminatou's role are not graded
Marina Vendrell's bargain with Valgavoth is not fully modelled
